Not measured yet Retries per merged task i Attempts beyond the first, per merged task. 0.00 CI pass rate i Merged / (merged + tasks the judge blocked for red checks). 100% Latest team scores i Newest evaluation per team. tm-c 60/5 Rejections per merged PR = rejection events / merged PRs; retries = attempts beyond the first; CI pass rate = merged / (merged + tasks the judge blocked for red checks). Rejections count failed QA/review verdicts, plus old judge rejections that left no verdict row. Merged counts tasks with a merge event. Tasks without a team are counted in every team of their goal.
